title: Resuming a Suspended Disability Compensation Award
content:
**Rule.** A suspended Disability Compensation award resumes once the veteran personally confirms, on the contact, the payment account now on the award, and that confirmation itself resumes the award and releases at once, as one retroactive payment citing no decision, every entitlement month the suspension left unpaid. It applies when no debt is in active collection and no incarceration adjustment applies to the months released, so nothing is withheld, and a release made when a suspension ends carries no fee withholding.

**Business effect.** The confirmation changes the award's status from suspended to running and clears its suspension reason, and books one retroactive payment entry on the award covering the span of entitlement months given, issued that day to the payment account on the award with single-signature authorization, linked to no rating decision and with nothing withheld, so the amount deposited equals the gross amount. Afterwards the award's status is running, monthly payments resume on the normal schedule, and the payment history shows the release.

**Invocation.** The confirmation is the veteran's own act. The representative unlocks the customer tool `resume_award_release_withheld_86166e35` and hands it over to the customer themselves — the veteran — who runs it in person on the contact.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `award_id` | The reference number of the veteran's Disability Compensation award, as shown on the award record returned by the compensation award lookup for this veteran |
| `retro_period_start` | The first entitlement month the release covers, YYYY-MM as the months appear on the award's payment entries |
| `retro_period_end` | The last entitlement month the release covers, YYYY-MM; a month for which no payment entry exists yet is written the same way (for example 2026-09) |
| `gross_amount` | The total amount released in US dollars: positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign or thousands separator |

**Receipt.** Status "award_resumed", the award status "running", the reference number of the new release entry, the first and last months covered (YYYY-MM), the issue date (YYYY-MM-DD), and gross and net amounts in US dollars to 2 decimal places, equal to each other.

**Questions the rule answers**

*What resumes the award?* The veteran's own confirmation, on the contact, of the payment account now on the award.

*Is anything withheld from the release?* Not when no debt is in active collection and no incarceration adjustment applies; and a release made when a suspension ends never carries fee withholding.

*Does the release cite a rating decision?* No; it cites no decision.
